responsibility: Declares the public C prototypes for the mc bootstrap runtime exception helpers implemented in Gmcrts.c. This header exposes the CaseException and ReturnException entry points with C linkage so generated or support code can call the language-runtime termination routines consistently.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file in the Gmcrts same-name pair: it provides include-guarded, C-linkage prototypes for CaseException and ReturnException so other code can call them. The companion .c file contains the actual diagnostic-and-exit implementations, plus the private _throw definition.
